title: Decision-lattice for staged cohort promote with deferred-promote policy and resumable snapshot recovery
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: current canary and shadow controllers support linear phased rollouts but lack expressive policy primitives to represent non-monotonic cohort promotions and resumable recovery after partial failures. This PR adds a decision-lattice execution model, a deferred-promote policy (time- and metric-gated delayed promotions), and snapshot-based resumable recovery for in-flight cohorts. Summary: implements a compact decision-lattice runtime, new rollout policy CRD fields (deferWindow, quorumExpression, snapshotRetention), snapshot capture and restore hooks, and operator-level reconciliation for resumable promote/abort. Backwards compatibility: existing rollout specs are unchanged and map to the lattice's default path. Main changes: new controller and reconciler, policy validation and migration script, operator metrics and tracing, e2e tests for pause/resume and snapshot restore, and CLI tooling to inspect lattice state. How it works: rollout is translated into a directed acyclic lattice of states where nodes represent cohort states and edges represent labeled transitions with guard expressions. A deferred-promote policy attaches a time-window and metric expression to promote transitions; if the guard evaluates false during the window the transition is re-evaluated at a configurable cadence. Snapshot-based resumable recovery captures minimal cohort state (traffic positions, KV cache markers, evaluation buckets) before risky transitions and stores them in the rollout namespace with lifecycle TTL. On controller restart or partial failure the reconciler can restore the last snapshot and resume the lattice execution, or fall back to a safety rollback path if snapshot integrity fails. Config examples: rollout.spec.policy: {"type":"deferred-promote","deferWindow":"10m","quorumExpression":"p95.latency<120&&errorRate<0.005","recheckInterval":"30s","snapshotRetention":"1h"} Implementation notes: optimized snapshot format uses compressed protobufs; snapshots are stored as k8s secrets encrypted with cluster KMS when available. We added unit tests covering guard parsing, checkpointing, and snapshot GC, plus integration scenarios with heterogeneous cohort quorums (latency-sensitive cohorts promoted independently). Testing: local canary e2e (kind cluster), a scaled simulation harness validating lattice topologies under injected failures, and benchmark runs measuring reconcilation tail-latency (no measurable regressions). Rollout of this feature will be gated behind a feature flag in the console and an opt-in annotation on rollout objects. Checklist: implement controller and reconcile loop, add CRD validation and conversion webhook, add snapshot store with KMS integration, add metrics and traces, add CLI inspect command, add e2e tests, update docs and examples, add migration script for existing staged rollouts. Risks and mitigations: snapshot size explosion mitigated by incremental checkpoints and TTL; snapshot restore safety validated by checksum and schema version; deferred-promote can cause extended partial exposure — we added global safety TTL and automatic rollback if total exposure exceeds budget. Related: Linear ENG-4127, ENG-4450.

review_comments: Evan Morales: Please add a short-circuit path for the lattice when the rollout annotation `redwood.io/skip-lattice` is set; otherwise operator will do unnecessary work.
Author (Aisha Patel): Added skip-lattice check and unit tests in a1b2c3e. Also added CLI flag to force evaluation even when skipped.
Priya Singh: Can we ensure snapshot encryption falls back gracefully when KMS is not configured? edge clusters should not fail the whole reconcile.
Author: Yes, snapshots default to namespace secrets unencrypted but flagged with audit metadata; when KMS is available controller uses envelope encryption. see snapshot/store.go for logic.
Luca Romano: Minor nit on metrics cardinality for lattice node labels; prefer coarser labels to avoid high cardinality in long-lived clusters.
Author: Reduced label dimensions and added aggregated gauges.
release_notes: Added decision-lattice rollout engine with deferred-promote policy and resumable snapshots. Feature is behind a feature flag and requires opt-in via rollout annotation. See docs for CLI inspection and migration steps.
